title: Project Max Entropy
description: A resource pack that randomizes nearly every visual texture and aspect of the game, brought to you by Excel macros.
body:
Nothing is right. Everything is randomized here. Well, almost everything... we can't have the universe become _too_ unstable...

Meant as a challenge resource pack. More often than not, you will have to use your brain to interpret what a block or an item is, rather than relying on your sight.

Entropy Levels: Mild
- ~~Block textures and names~~
- ~~Item textures and names~~
- ~~Advancement messages~~
- ~~Death messages~~
- Block entities (beds, banners, chests, etc.)
- Sounds
- Music
- Entity models

Built off of the resource pack Vanilla Default 1.21.3. Thank you to its creator!

![The End island, with retextured blocks and a retextured Dragon Egg.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/156055fa086290d8c6547b790f7dfa2a4be0a718.png)
![The Creative inventory with a spruce biome in the background. The textures and names of the items on screen are all different or wrong.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/26de786793fd66c40fce9602a4004a50ddd601b8_0.webp)
